title: CORA One-Run Assurance: universal activity governance and forensic atlas
abstract_goal: From one existing process-run command, discover every available CORA activity, plan and govern execution according to independent authorization, collect provenance-rich evidence and expose all results and omissions through one navigable offline forensic atlas.

preservation_rules: Do not rename, remove or weaken PR36 original 27 nodes/edges or source versus external distinction.
Do not duplicate process_suite as a second source executor.
Do not claim the 71 commands have been executed because they are catalogued.
Do not promote source Git replay or local test exits to independently attested runtime.
Do not treat mutation vectors as physical source mutants or real-world defects.

invocation_target.compatibility: Extend existing cora process-run; no second orchestrator and no breaking change to PR36 safe defaults
invocation_target.safe_default: Read-only Git-source assurance; all executable effects disabled until explicit separately verified authorization

activity_registry.discoverability_rule: No orphan discovered surface, unregistered executor, duplicate owner or unreported unavailable activity
activity_registry.policy: Catalogued does not mean executed; safe source work can be automated, effectful and remote work requires independent authorization

outcomes.invariant: An output is PASS only for a named obligation and the required proof level; no aggregate PASS for unverified runtime, unknowns, unauthorized actions or incomplete product gates.

nodes.obligation: Replay all exact 27 existing PR36 nodes and original-Git source predicates without modifying their identities, dependencies or evidence authority.
Derive CLI inventory from actual parser/dispatch, reconcile the 71-command baseline and all changes, reject missing/extra/duplicate IDs.
Discover declared executable tooling, unit/integration tests, source verifiers, benchmark/stress runners, CI workflows and externally operated activities; record unresolvable surfaces.

Versioned execution registry with stable activity_id, version, owner, kind, entrypoint, parser/call-path, inputs, outputs, effect_class, trust, prerequisites, verifier, runtime policy and evidence schema.

Every discoverable executable surface maps exactly once to a canonical registered activity or an explicit justified alias; every registered entry resolves to a real owner; unmatched is a blocking discrepancy.
Product, software, repository, deliverable, runtime and external host identities, plus Git BASE/HEAD/working-tree state, are separate first-class references.
Compile deterministic cycle-free dependency DAG from activity registry, declared DoD requirements and selected profile; expose all planned/non-selected activities.
Validate user intent, fixed Git objects, input predicates, profile, host constraints and task parameter contracts before scheduling; reject cross-revision/source mixing.
Reuse results only with matching input, environment, revision, verifier and policy keys; shared execution cannot be counted as independent observations.
Predeclare time, CPU, memory, disk, output size, retries and cancellation policy; failures and timeouts remain visible.
Classify all activities READ_ONLY/LOCAL_EXEC/WRITE_REPO/REMOTE_EFFECT/RELEASE; default READ_ONLY, deny unsafe action unless an external authorization is bound to exact activity+revision+scope.
For code execution define isolated ephemeral environment, pinned image/toolchain, controlled network, secret isolation, filesystem mounts and resource limits; local opt-in is not sandbox attestation.
Reuse existing process_suite and one_run pipeline; expose the eight existing source methods and their measured/direct/reused/not-run outcomes without duplication.
Provide typed adapters for existing CLI, tool verifiers, tests, benchmarks and CI observations, with an explicit unsupported/manual adapter; never blindly recurse over the 71 CLI commands.
Every activity has one explicit terminal state with eligibility, authorization, execution, verification and proof level stored as orthogonal fields; no implicit PASS.
Emit stable per-test identifiers, class/name, attempt, expected/observed outcome, failure traceback, log and artifacts for optional authorized tests; distinguish collection failure from 0 tests.
Block dependent tasks after failed prerequisites, retain originating exception/root cause, do not hide intermediate FAIL or timeout; allow only bounded explicit retries.
Record exact repo identity, BASE/HEAD/commit/tree, dirty state and source hashes; provenance from Git must not claim runtime or human attestation.
Capture toolchain/OS/Python/dependency hashes, runner image identity, runtime policy, command argv, cwd, environment allowlist fingerprint and clock source without leaking credentials.
For every attempt store event sequence, input/output hashes, status transition, duration, exit, stdout/stderr content-addressed references, bounded retention and observed errors.
Carry claim→DoD→activity→attempt→artifact→verifier→observation links with original source and trust domain; no self-hash-only verification.
Missing, truncated, unauthenticated, stale, external-only and blocked evidence remain separate searchable gaps with exact reasons and collection next steps.
Preserve PR36 original-Git report recomputation and HTML replay, reject forged reports, cross-commit and changed mandatory DoD edges.
Reconcile locally captured process events against manifest and attached logs without claiming external authenticity; compare witnesses independently where possible.
Rebuild deterministic summary and navigational HTML from immutable captured dossier, verify digests and stable artifact refs; separate deterministic bytes from inherently variable runtime timings.
One offline Atlas entrypoint with run identity, global gate, task matrix, source vs runtime vs independent evidence, risk and unexecuted reasons.
For every registered activity, test case, failure and mutated counterexample provide navigable details, timeline, inputs, dependency chain, logs and original artifacts.
Interactive graph/list of obligations with statuses, blockers, minimum unsatisfied cut, upstream evidence, affected claims and actionable next check.
No remote dependencies by default; safe escaping, keyboard navigation, search/filter, semantic markup, large-run pagination and offline relative artifact links.
Report explicit denominators for discovery, eligibility, execution, verification, proof completeness, failures, runtime, cost and novelty; never conflate declared and executed commands.
Every unsatisfied DoD, unknown/blocked capability or missing evidence creates a deduplicated gap with owner, priority, source, falsifier, next step and reopen condition.
Reconcile active README/architecture/CLI/reference assertions against parser, Git and verified host facts, distinguish current vs historical vs source-only.
Preserve PR36 100k preseeded distinct vectors, 32 families, seed 883, two deterministic replays and zero oracle disagreements/unsafe promotions.

Apply independently specified negative tests to registry drift, untrusted execution, artifact loss, test-level failure, spoofed approvals, graph omission, replay/HTML and host truth; physical Git mutants separately counted.
Run strict source contract checks and representative system-integration tests on exact final HEAD and supported Python versions; retain original external obligations.
Independently verify actual OS/container isolation and network/filesystem/secret egress limits for code execution.
External authorization must identify exact revision, permitted effects, environment and approver; CORA cannot grant itself authority.
Independent runner/observer corroborates selected execution outcomes with runtime metadata and retained raw test records.
Non-CORA maintained targets have labeled ground truth, independent oracle, preregistered metrics and repeatable comparative runs.
Verify actual protected-main required checks, permission roles, authenticated independent review and host-side gate enforcement.
Unfamiliar users complete preregistered tasks on a real browser and correctly distinguish source evidence from executed/unattested results.
Qualified wheel/sdist, release provenance, owner approval, rollback procedure and real acceptance evidence are independently recorded.
Measure wall-clock and analyst effort versus baseline on maintained non-CORA repositories, including false positives and follow-up effort.
Closed discovery and executable semantics for all CORA capabilities in scope.
Deterministic explainable plan and selected profile with resource/identity controls.
Correct execution-control implementation and boundaries, not runtime sandbox attestation.
Provenance-preserving unified raw evidence and missing-proof accounting.
Original-Git replay and honest local execution reconciliation.
One offline browsable forensic atlas, not simply a summary report.
Every activity and evidence obligation is accounted for; explicit gaps and synchronized current documentation.
Repeatable PR36 regression plus new adversarial scope and truthful CI evidence.
PR36-preserving, source-scoped One-Run integrated assurance implementation.
Actually authorized and independently isolated optional execution with independent runtime evidence.
Externally measured behavioral, usability, operational and host-governance acceptance.
Release-ready globally accepted one-command assurance product, without local self-authorization.

per_test_traceability.required: 1.0 when runner supports per-test results; unsupported => BLOCKED

unsafe_authorization_count.formula: unauthorized effectful actions or status promotions

wrong_revision_joins.formula: cross revision/environment mismatches promoted as verified

mutation_control.required: two identical replay digests; 0 oracle disagreements; 0 unsafe promotions

new_mutation_quality.formula: new negative/positive/physical/real classes individually counted and survival ratios reported
new_mutation_quality.required: zero high-critical unsafe survivors; no artificial target counts

independent_benchmark.formula: precision, recall, false-positive, elapsed, baseline and truth-label disagreements, by target
independent_benchmark.required: preregistered external acceptance thresholds; >= 3 maintained non-CORA repos

newcomer_interpretation.formula: task success and epistemic classification mistakes across >=2 novice testers
newcomer_interpretation.required: 0 source-vs-runtime authority confusions for mandatory acceptance tasks

run_cost.formula: CPU, memory, disk, wall time and analyst minutes; cold/warm and failure profiles
run_cost.required: reported with fixed workload and baseline; budget compliance explicitly scored

checklist.criterion: Parser commands count equals canonical registry CLI count; no missing, extra, duplicate or unresolved dispatch; historical 71 is a baseline, not a permanently hardcoded count.
Every tool, CI, test/benchmark/verifier and external observation has a registered owner or explicit nonexecutable/manual classification.
Each activity states prerequisites, authority/effect class, test-level output shape, verifier and source witness.
One command generates a stable topologically sorted plan with selected, blocked, not-applicable and not-selected activities.
BASE/HEAD/tree, policy, environment and budgets are pinned; runs cannot combine unrelated sources as one observation.
Without approval, no network, arbitrary test code, write to repository, release or host mutation is performed.
Optional execution requires independent policy-bound authorization and measured sandbox properties; repository file identity alone is insufficient.
All eligible authorized tasks either produce terminal result/attempt or explicit cancellation/block reason; no silent success.
Source methods preserve PR36 outcomes; reused methods are never counted as independent executions.
Every executed unit test has case ID, attempt, status, duration, error/log and artifact links; collection failure is not zero tests.
Every attempted task has manifest identity, command, environment, hash-bound outputs, complete error and raw evidence retention or explicit truncation flag.
Source, local observation, third-party attestation and authorization are separate trust classes.
Source replay uses original Git; execution reconciliation does not invent runtime signatures; tampered logs/receipts are rejected.
Atlas regeneration is deterministic from one immutable normalized dossier; volatile timing is not misrepresented as repeatable.
One offline entrypoint gives dashboard, task matrix and drill-down from every activity to test/error/evidence/lineage.
DoD blockers, unsatisfied cut, verifier, owner and actionable next step reachable by navigation; no buried gaps.
Accessibility, keyboard navigation, escaping, offline behavior and large-report performance are tested.
All discovered capabilities explicitly classified; 100% coverage of classification, not 100% unsafe execution.
All failed/blocked/unknown obligations surface in machine-readable gap register; current docs cannot contradict observed source/host truth.
Metrics state denominators and distinguish executed, reused, modeled, verified, independent and unrun counts.
Existing 100k PR36 preseeded model with 32 families and seed 883 still replays twice; zero oracle disagreement and false promotion.
New failure families include omission, cycle, authorization spoof, secret egress, missing per-test item, truncated logs, environment mismatch, falsified host pass and atlas XSS.
Physical Git mutants, synthetic vectors, real repository benchmarks and actual executions are reported as different populations.
CI tests run on exact final HEAD and check both positive controls and refusals; no masking of intermittent failures.
Third-party observer validates execution environment isolation and runtime receipts; opt-in or process exit alone is insufficient.
External benchmark includes at least three maintained non-CORA repositories, independently labeled oracles, preregistered success criteria and failure analyses.
At least two first-time users complete task-based atlas usability test; record comprehension errors, time-to-evidence and mistaken authority assumptions.
Protected main, trusted checks and distinct reviewer identity independently verified; host 403 is NOT evidence of PASS.
Quantify cost and human effort versus baseline including warm/cold runs, failure cases, p50/p95 and follow-up effort.
Formal release provenance, approved owner, rollback evidence and separately recorded external acceptance before production-ready claim.

priority_workstreams.acceptance: No CURRENT contradiction; independent host controls attested or BLOCKED_EXTERNAL
Exact parser/dispatch coverage and all nonCLI classes reconciled
Independent non-CORA target oracles and baseline comparison
Full typed dossier with per-test and per-error navigation
Observed task success, comprehension and cost

non_claims: Not an instruction to auto-execute every available command
Not proof that all 71 parser commands have run
Not independent runtime or environment attestation
Not host permission to modify, merge or publish
Not proof that no unmodelled activity exists outside independently surveyed boundaries
deployment_note: Proposal for PR37 and later acceptance gates; not committed to GitHub and not an executed proof.
